> Eod · 2026-09-23

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Pipeliners\reports\eod-2026-09-23-indexing.html`
Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-23.txt`

Wednesday. Indexing day for both Pipeliners and Summit AZ, using free Search Console requests only. The Pipeliners HTML file is a formatted "Pipeliners Indexing Report" version of the same Pipeliners EOD (before/after table per page).

# Pipeliners
Files: `EOD Report 2026-09-23.txt` and `reports\eod-2026-09-23-indexing.html`. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Tracker baseline: 114 pages, 86 in Google, 28 not. Crawled all 28 and grouped them: 6 ready to submit, 3 already requested, 9 now 301 into merged posts, 4 out on purpose (/thank-you/, /sales-cost-estimator/, /free-sewer-repair-estimate/, empty category), 4 waiting on the Sep 17 merges, 2 waiting on content.
- Submitted 6 on Sep 22; by Sep 23, 4 indexed, /sewer-line-maintenance/ already in, /free-video-inspection/ still out (old 404 record, only 78 words). The 3 earlier requests (/blog/, repipe post, /clay-sewer-pipe/) confirmed indexed.
- Net: 86 to 93 pages in Google out of 114. Tracker updated (v22 and v23) and an indexing report artifact published.
- Quota stopped the 6 merge-target pages; scheduled an automatic run for Sep 23 at 11:45 PM (needs app and Chrome open).

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
File: `Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-23.txt`. See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- GSC listed 53 "not indexed" URLs but only 10 are real pages (the rest are feeds, plugin files, search URLs, redirects and intentional noindex).
- Submitted 4 before the daily limit. Recheck: /home-warranty-plumbing/ and the Apache Junction emergency page (from Sep 21) now indexed; 3 waiting; 5 not yet submitted.
- The home warranty page had no internal links pointing to it.
- Tracker refreshed: 201 pages, 168 indexed, 12 not, 9 noindex on purpose, 8 redirects, 4 unreported.

# Follow-ups
- Pipeliners: Kim to decide whether /pipelining/ (Ads page) should be indexed and whether to rewrite or retire the pipeline-locating post; Scott to supply original copy for the leak detection page; recheck /free-video-inspection/ Sep 30 (fix is content, not another request); move the tracker share pin.
- Summit: submit the remaining baseline pages plus emergency, general plumbing, sewer, softener and new blog URLs; recheck the 3 waiting pages Sep 30; Kim's call on an internal link to the home warranty page.
